imports.title: Import history
imports.description: Every bank statement imported across your reconcilable accounts.
imports.search: Search by date, source, or account…
imports.emptyDescription: Import an OFX or CSV statement from an account to see it here.

reconsPage.title: Reconciliations
reconsPage.description: Open and signed-off reconciliations across all accounts.
reconsPage.emptyDescription: Start a reconciliation from a bank or card account to see it here.

rules.title: Reconciliation rules
rules.description: Automatically clear recurring bank lines — match by description or amount, then exclude them or post a categorizing entry.
rules.emptyDescription: Create a rule to auto-categorize or exclude recurring bank lines like fees, interest, or transfers.
rules.runDescription: Apply active rules to every unmatched bank line on the selected account.
rules.runDone: {matched, plural, one {# line matched} other {# lines matched}} · {excluded, plural, one {# excluded} other {# excluded}}
rules.drawerDescription: Rules run top-down by priority; the first match wins.
rules.deleteConfirm: Delete this rule? This cannot be undone.
rules.offsetHint: A journal is posted moving the bank line against this account, then matched automatically.
rules.excludeHint: The line is marked excluded and skipped during reconciliation.

match.title: Match bank data
match.description: Match imported bank lines against the ledger, run rules, and clear your reconciliation — one account at a time.
match.unmatchedCount: {count, plural, one {# to match} other {# to match}}
match.pickDescription: Choose a bank or card account above to see its unmatched bank lines and the ledger activity to match them against.
match.noSessionDescription: Start matching to open a reconciliation for this account at its latest statement date and balance.
match.addJournalHint: Posts a balanced journal moving this line against the offset account, then matches it.
match.reviewHint: Low-confidence auto-matches — confirm they're right, or unmatch to redo.
match.noReview: Nothing to review — auto-matches were all high-confidence.
match.excludedHint: Lines you've set aside — they're skipped when reconciling.

transactionsEmptyDescription: Write a check, record a card charge, or transfer funds between accounts.

account.description: {details} — import statements, then match and sign off.
account.statementsEmptyDescription: Import an OFX or CSV statement to bring this account's bank activity in.
account.reconciliationsEmptyDescription: Start a reconciliation with the bank statement's cutoff date and closing balance.

import.title: Import bank statement
import.description: Paste OFX or CSV text, or pick a file — it is read in your browser and imported as parsed lines.
import.importCount: Import {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}}
import.importedToast: {imported, plural, one {Imported # line} other {Imported # lines}}{duplicates, plural, =0 {} one { — # duplicate skipped} other { — # duplicates skipped}}
import.previewSummary: {imported, plural, one {# new line} other {# new lines}}{duplicates, plural, =0 {} one { · # duplicate skipped} other { · # duplicates skipped}}
import.mappingHelp: With a debit column mapped, Amount is treated as the credit (money-in) column and debits import negated. Ambiguous numeric dates are read as MM/DD/YYYY.
import.nothingNew: Every parsed line already exists on this account — nothing new to import.
import.moreLines: …and {count, plural, one {# more line} other {# more lines}}

start.title: Start reconciliation
start.description: Enter the bank statement's cutoff date and its closing balance — the workspace matches everything up to that date.

drawer.title: Statement {date}
drawer.deleteDraftBody: This permanently deletes the draft. This cannot be undone.
drawer.deletePostedBody: This permanently deletes the document and removes its ledger impact. This cannot be undone.
drawer.formPreferredFailed: Could not save the preferred form

reconcile.title: Reconcile through {date}
reconcile.description: Match bank statement lines to posted journal lines until the difference is 0.00, then sign off.

workspace.signedOffAlert: This reconciliation is signed off — the matched journal lines below are permanently stamped as reconciled.
workspace.signOffDisabledTitle: Difference must be 0.00 to sign off
workspace.autoMatchedToast: {count, plural, one {Auto-matched # line} other {Auto-matched # lines}} ({high} high, {medium} medium confidence)
workspace.signOffConfirm: Sign off this reconciliation? Matched journal lines are stamped as reconciled — this cannot be undone.
workspace.signedOffToast: Signed off — {count, plural, one {# journal line reconciled} other {# journal lines reconciled}}
workspace.discardConfirm: Discard this reconciliation session? Its matches are undone and statement lines released.
workspace.noBankLinesSearch: No bank lines match this search.
workspace.allBankLinesMatched: Every statement line up to the cutoff is matched.
workspace.noGlLinesSearch: No ledger lines match this search.
workspace.allGlLinesReconciled: Every posted line up to the cutoff is reconciled or matched.
workspace.noMatchesSearch: No matches found for this search.
workspace.noMatchesYet: Nothing matched yet — run Auto-match or pair lines manually above.
workspace.adjustDescription: Change the cutoff date or the bank statement balance for this session.

sftp.title: SFTP
sftp.description: A secure SFTP drop-off for exchanging files with your banks and partners. Give them a login and the connection details below, and they can send you statement files or pick up payment files.
sftp.endpointHint: Where clients connect. Share these details with your bank or partner, along with a login below.
sftp.emptyDescription: The endpoint above is running and ready. Add a login to give a bank or partner their own secure, password-protected drop-off folder.
sftp.newServerHint: A username and password are generated. Hand them, plus the endpoint details above, to the bank or partner.
sftp.createNote: The password is shown once after creation — copy it then. You can rotate it later if it’s lost.
sftp.deleteConfirm: Delete login "{name}"? Connections using it stop working.
sftp.credsHint: Copy these now — the password is not shown again.
sftp.credsWarning: Store the password securely. Anyone with it can read and write this folder over SFTP.
sftp.settingsHint: Configure the connection details banks and partners use to reach your SFTP drop-off.
sftp.advertisedHostHint: The hostname shown to users in connection details. Defaults to this app’s host.

schedules.title: Scheduled imports
schedules.description: Watch a folder on a login and import new statement files into a bank account automatically.
schedules.newScheduleHint: Files dropped into the folder are parsed and imported each run, then moved to a processed/ subfolder.
schedules.needsLogin: Add a login above first — a schedule watches a folder on one.
schedules.needsAccount: Add a reconcilable bank account first — imports land in one.
schedules.ran: Imported {imported} from {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}
schedules.formatHint: Auto-detects OFX, CAMT.053, BAI2 and MT940 by extension/content; CSV needs a column mapping.

sftp.authorizedKeysHint: One OpenSSH public key per line. Clients with a matching private key can log in without a password.

cash.title: Cash
cash.description: Your liquidity control center — cash on hand, runway, and the weeks ahead.

panels.timelineHint: Click a week to see what flows in and out · {weeks} weeks

cash.negativeAlert: Projected to go cash-negative — low of {amount} the week of {date}. Slow payables or accelerate collections.
cash.deferralNote: {amount} of payables can't be paid within the horizon under the current AP capacity settings — the backlog spills past the last week.
cash.configDescription: Tune how AP-to-pay is selected and add recurring flows (payroll, rent, loans) the AR/AP pipeline doesn’t capture.
